# Known vulnerabilities that the tested versions cannot avoid yet. CI fails on any other one.
# Each line: the advisory ID, then why it stays. Remove a line as soon as a fixed version installs.
#
# qwen-asr 0.0.6 (the listening engine) requires transformers==4.57.6 and accelerate==1.12.0
# exactly, so no newer release of either can be installed beside it. These advisories concern
# loading untrusted checkpoints, model repositories or training state, or saving to paths a
# stranger names; tarjim loads only the models it names itself. Reviewed 2026-10-15.
PYSEC-2026-3804 accelerate 1.12.0, path traversal in sharded checkpoint loading; no fixed release
PYSEC-2025-217 transformers 4.57.6, X-CLIP checkpoint conversion; no fixed release
PYSEC-2026-2288 transformers 4.57.6, Trainer state loading; fixed in 5.0.0
PYSEC-2026-2289 transformers 4.57.6, crafted config.json in a model repository; fixed in 5.3.0
PYSEC-2026-2290 transformers 4.57.6, LightGlue remote code; fixed in 5.5.0
PYSEC-2026-3929 transformers 4.57.6, save_pretrained path traversal; fixed in 5.10.0
PYSEC-2026-4174 transformers 4.57.6, load_custom_generate writes remote files; no fixed release
